Job Description

At Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), we are building the next generation of cloud services for autonomous and intelligent robotics.

OCI Robotics Cloud is Oracle's strategic cloud platform for robotics. Our mission is to enable enterprises to seamlessly onboard, manage, monitor, and operate heterogeneous robot fleets through secure, scalable, AI-powered cloud services.

Unlike traditional robotics platforms that focus on individual robots, OCI Robotics Cloud is building the cloud operating system for robotics—providing common services for robot identity, registration, fleet management, mission orchestration, telemetry, digital twins, software lifecycle management, and AI-powered automation.

A key part of our vision is an AI-driven, spec-based robot onboarding platform
that enables robots from any vendor to integrate rapidly through standardized cloud interfaces, reusable edge services, and AI-generated service contracts.

As Director of OCI Robotics Cloud, you will build both the platform and the organization that will define Oracle's long-term robotics strategy.

This is a rare opportunity to build a greenfield cloud platform with executive visibility and industry-wide impact at the intersection of AI, cloud infrastructure, robotics, and edge computing.

Responsibilities

About You

You are a builder.

You enjoy creating organizations, platforms, and engineering cultures from the ground up.

You have successfully led engineering teams building large-scale cloud platforms and understand how to balance long-term technical vision with rapid execution.

You believe great platforms are built around reusable abstractions, developer productivity, and operational excellence.

You are passionate about AI and understand how generative AI can fundamentally improve software engineering, developer experience, and platform automation.

You have a proven track record of hiring, mentoring, and growing exceptional engineering organizations.

You communicate effectively with engineers, architects, product leaders, customers, and executive leadership.

What You'll Do

Define the Platform

Define the long-term architecture and technical vision for OCI Robotics Cloud.
Build the cloud platform enabling robot registration, identity, fleet management, mission orchestration, telemetry, digital twins, and software lifecycle management.
Establish common APIs, service contracts, SDKs, and edge service frameworks that support robots from multiple vendors.

Lead AI-driven Engineering

Lead the development of an AI-assisted, spec-driven robot onboarding platform where AI generates service contracts, edge service specifications, SDKs, implementation guidance, and developer documentation.
Drive adoption of AI throughout the software development lifecycle to improve engineering productivity and platform quality.

Build the Organization

Recruit, mentor, and grow a world-class cloud engineering organization.
Build a culture centered on engineering excellence, ownership, customer obsession, and continuous innovation.
Coach engineering managers and senior technical leaders while developing future organizational leadership.

Deliver at Scale

Drive engineering execution across architecture, planning, prioritization, delivery, reliability, security, observability, and operational excellence.
Partner closely with Product Management to define roadmap and customer adoption strategy.
Collaborate across OCI AI, Cloud Infrastructure, Security, Networking, Developer Services, and strategic robotics partners.
Represent OCI Robotics Cloud in executive reviews, customer engagements, and strategic technology initiatives.

Minimum Qualifications

BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Robotics, or a related technical field.
12+ years of experience building distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, or enterprise software platforms.
5+ years of engineering management experience leading multiple software engineering teams.
Proven experience defining and delivering large-scale cloud platforms from concept to production.
Strong technical background in distributed systems, Kubernetes, APIs, microservices, cloud-native architectures, and modern software engineering practices.
Demonstrated success hiring and scaling engineering organizations.
Outstanding communication, leadership, and organizational skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with cloud robotics, IoT, autonomous systems, or edge computing platforms.
Familiarity with ROS 2 and modern robotics software architectures.
Experience with DDS, MQTT, OPC-UA, VDA5050, or related robotics communication technologies.
Experience building developer platforms, SDKs, APIs, or service contract frameworks.
Experience with AI-assisted software development, developer productivity platforms, or agentic AI systems.
Exposure to embodied AI, vision-language models, robot fleet management, digital twins, or teleoperation platforms.
Experience working with heterogeneous hardware ecosystems and partner integrations.

Why Join Us

Build Oracle's cloud platform for the next generation of intelligent robotics.
Pioneer AI-driven, spec-based robot onboarding technologies.
Define the open cloud interfaces that enable robots from any vendor to integrate with OCI.
Lead one of Oracle's newest strategic engineering organizations.
Collaborate with world-class engineers across OCI AI, Cloud Infrastructure, Security, and Developer Services.
Shape Oracle's long-term strategy for cloud robotics, AI, and autonomous systems.

Vision

Our vision is to make robot onboarding as simple as cloud onboarding.

We believe AI will fundamentally transform how robots are integrated into enterprise systems by automatically generating service contracts, edge services, SDKs, APIs, implementation guidance, and operational best practices.

OCI Robotics Cloud is building the cloud platform that allows any robot—from any vendor—to securely connect to Oracle Cloud through standardized interfaces rather than custom integrations.

As Director of OCI Robotics Cloud, you will build the engineering organization that turns this vision into reality.

The Company

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:

This role leads the engineering organization that owns how PayPal creates, protects, distributes, rotates, and retires cryptographic material - keys, certificates, secrets, and the services and hardware that sit behind them. You will lead managers and senior engineers across public key infrastructure and certificate lifecycle management, key management and HSM platforms, cryptographic libraries and services, secrets management, and the enterprise crypto-agility and post-quantum readiness program.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

Provide expert advice and strategic counsel to senior executives, shaping the development of multi-year security strategies that align with business goals and long-term objectives.
Determine the most effective methods and strategies for addressing complex security challenges, driving innovation through collaboration with cross-functional teams to shape the organization’s security landscape.
Identify and resolve unique, high-impact security challenges, applying deep expertise to situations of substantial significance, and developing innovative solutions that influence the organization’s security framework.
Drive the future technology roadmap, shaping the security vision that supports and enables business growth and competitive advantage.
Lead the development and execution of key components of the multi-year security strategy, contributing to the broader security agenda within the organization.
Inspire and motivate team(s) to pursue innovative solutions, ensuring alignment with the overall security strategy and business objectives, while fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement.

Minimum Qualifications:

10+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.
2 years of experience leading others

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Roughly 12+ years in software, platform, or security engineering, including 5+ years leading engineering teams and experience leading other managers.
Ownership of production cryptographic infrastructure at enterprise scale, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, key management, HSMs, or cryptographic services, with applied fluency in TLS and trust stores, key hierarchies and rotation, and HSM integration. This is an engineering leadership role rather than a cryptographic research role.
Experience running platforms under regulatory scrutiny, PCI DSS, SOC 2, FIPS 140-2/140-3, or comparable, and working directly with auditors and examiners.
A track record of large migrations across many dependent teams where success depended on influence and sequencing rather than direct authority, and the communication skills to give executives the risk and the decision rather than the cryptography.

You will shape the strategy, delivery, and operational health of PayPal's cryptographic platforms — the foundation beneath uninterrupted payment availability, provable regulatory compliance, and a credible path to quantum-resistant cryptography ahead of external deadlines. Concretely, most of that impact comes through the organization you build and lead:

Managers and engineers across PKI, key management, cryptographic services, and post-quantum readiness work from one roadmap instead of several competing ones, and know how their work ladders into it.
Leaders in the portfolio take on real scope, make their own calls, and develop successors behind them.
In a specialist field this small, retention is a leadership outcome long before it is a recruiting one.
Cloud Modernization, Platform Engineering, Identity, SRE, Risk, and Compliance adopt cryptographic standards because the case is clear and the partnership is real.
What is exposed, what it would cost, and what you propose to do about it — framed so leadership can decide on time rather than after an incident.

Additional Responsibilities

Lead a multi-team organization of managers, technical leads, and engineers across time zones, setting direction and staying close enough to the technology to make good calls without becoming the bottleneck.
Hire, develop, and retain cryptographic engineering talent, building bench strength and succession in a domain where single points of knowledge are a business continuity risk.
Own the multi-year roadmap across PKI and certificate lifecycle management, key management and HSM platforms, cryptographic services, and secrets, including vendor strategy across CAs, HSM manufacturers, and CLM platforms.
Drive the enterprise crypto-agility and post-quantum program, from cryptographic inventory and risk-ranking through migration waves and executive-level reporting.
Push certificate and key operations toward automation by default, ACME and API-driven issuance, self-service onboarding, short-lived credentials, with named ownership for every certificate in the estate.
Lead through cryptography-related incidents and regulatory examinations alike, partnering with Compliance, Internal Audit, and Risk on PCI DSS and SOC, and converting findings into durable control changes.
Represent cryptography to the CISO's leadership team and to business and engineering executives, and track where the field is heading, standards drafts, CA/Browser Forum ballots, NIST and NSA guidance, so PayPal's plans adjust early.

The Developer Tools space is evolving rapidly as advances in large language models (LLMs), AI agents, and intelligent automation create new possibilities for how software is designed, built, tested, deployed, and operated. . You will build and develop a high-performing engineering team, establish priorities and operating mechanisms, and create clarity where requirements and technical approaches are still evolving. You will work closely with senior engineers, product managers, data scientists, AI/ML teams, and OCI service organizations to identify high-impact opportunities and take them from early exploration through architecture, production deployment, and broad adoption.

You will be expected to balance experimentation with disciplined execution—enabling teams to move quickly in a rapidly changing AI landscape while maintaining the engineering rigor, security, reliability, and operational excellence expected of OCI services.

Build, lead, and develop a high-performing engineering organization , hiring and growing engineers and technical leaders while establishing a culture of ownership, technical excellence, collaboration, and customer focus.

10+ years of software engineering experience , including experience designing and delivering complex production systems, with 3+ years of engineering management experience leading and developing software engineering teams.

Experience driving complex initiatives from early exploration and architecture through production delivery, operational maturity, and adoption , including managing dependencies and priorities across multiple teams.

BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Experience defining and using developer productivity, platform adoption, AI quality, or business-impact metrics to evaluate investments and guide engineering and product strategy.

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

Anthropic manages one of the largest and fastest-growing infrastructure fleets in the industry — spanning multiple accelerator families, CPU families, and clouds. The Capacity Engineering team is responsible for making sure all of our infrastructure resources are accounted for, well-utilized, and efficiently allocated. We own the data, tooling, and operational systems that let Anthropic plan, measure, and maximize utilization across first-party and third-party compute — one of the company's largest areas of spend.

As the Senior Engineering Manager for Capacity Engineering, you will lead the team that builds and operates these production systems. You'll set technical direction, grow and develop a team of senior and staff-level engineers, and be accountable for the reliability and correctness of surfaces that leadership, research engineering, inference, infrastructure, and finance all depend on. This is a hands-on leadership role and will be onsite 5 days a week: we expect you to stay close enough to the systems to review designs, make sound architectural calls, and step into an incident when the team needs you — while spending most of your time on people, priorities, and cross-organizational alignment.

The team's work spans three overlapping areas, and you'll be responsible for balancing investment across them as business priorities shift:

Data platform — Pipelines that ingest occupancy and utilization telemetry from Kubernetes clusters, normalize billing and usage across cloud providers, and serve the BigQuery tables the rest of the org queries against. Consumers range from research engineers to finance to leadership, so this is product work as much as engineering.
Planning and Assurance — Making the state of the fleet legible and actionable in real time: cluster health tooling, capacity planning platforms, alerting on occupancy drops and allocation problems, and systemic fixes to scheduling and fragmentation.
Efficiency — Measuring and improving how effectively every major workload uses the hardware it runs on, across training, inference, and evals. Building benchmarking infrastructure and per-config baselines, then partnering with system-owning teams to close the gaps.

Key Responsibilities

Be hands-on, lead and grow the team. Hire, onboard, coach, and retain senior and staff engineers. Set clear expectations, give direct and timely feedback, run performance and leveling conversations, and build a team culture that values ownership, rigor, and collaboration.
Champion your internal customers. We build for our own use cases, so the teams that depend on our systems — research engineering, inference, infrastructure, and finance — are your customers. Engage with them directly, bring what you learn back into the roadmap, and lead the team in building tools people genuinely want to use.
Own the roadmap. Translate company-level compute strategy into a prioritized engineering roadmap across data platform, planning and efficiency. Make explicit trade-offs when priorities compete, and communicate them clearly upward and outward.
Set the technical bar. Review designs, weigh in on architecture, and hold the team to production standards — well-tested Python and SQL, latency and completeness SLOs, gap detection, and on-call that is sustainable.
Run the team as a product organization. Ensure the team gathers its own requirements, defines schema contracts, and designs for a wide range of consumers — from research engineers to a CFO. Treat data quality and discoverability as first-class deliverables.
Be the primary partner for cross-functional stakeholders. Work closely with infrastructure, inference, research engineering, and finance leadership to align on capacity decisions, efficiency targets, and spend. Represent the team's data and recommendations to senior leadership.
Drive operational excellence. Own reliability and incident response for load-bearing systems, establish SLOs and on-call practices, and continuously reduce operational toil so the team can spend its time on higher-leverage work.
Scale the function. As the fleet diversifies (every new provider is a net-new integration), anticipate where the team needs to grow in headcount, skills, and systems — and make the case for it.

What You Bring

Experience managing software or infrastructure engineering teams, including hiring senior engineers, managing performance, and developing people into larger scope.
A strong technical background in production systems — data engineering, infrastructure, distributed systems, or observability — with hands-on experience you can still draw on when reviewing designs or debugging with the team.
Familiarity with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure), Kubernetes-based infrastructure, and modern observability stacks (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana).
A track record of setting and executing an engineering roadmap in an ambiguous, high-autonomy environment with many stakeholders and shifting priorities.
Excellent communication skills: you can explain a utilization metric to a research engineer and a spend forecast to a CFO, and you can advocate clearly for your team's priorities with senior leadership.
Comfort owning operational responsibility for systems the company depends on, including on-call and incident management.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience leading teams working on capacity planning, resource management, product engineering or FinOps at a hyperscaler or in a large-scale ML environment.
Familiarity with accelerator infrastructure — GPU metrics (DCGM), TPU utilization, or ML training and inference systems at the hardware level.
Experience with multi-cloud billing and telemetry normalization (billing exports, reservation APIs, commitments, on-demand capacity reservations).
Experience building or leading internal data products with self-service access, schema contracts, and documentation.
Background in scheduling, packing efficiency, or profiling-driven optimization of large distributed workloads.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

$405,000—$485,000 USD

Logistics

Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Job Overview

Reporting directly to the Chief Information Officer, the Vice President, Technology Strategy and Engineering leads Citadel’s Build-the-Future technology organization and is accountable for modernization, engineering capability, enterprise integration, and simplification of the technology portfolio. 
The Vice President provides executive leadership for Software Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Enterprise Data Services, AI & Automation, and Technology Products & Platforms. The role translates enterprise technology direction into target-state architecture, engineering and platform roadmaps, trusted data capabilities, reusable integration services, responsible AI solutions, and modern banking technologies that support Citadel’s continued growth.
This position serves as a key strategic partner across the organization, helping position Citadel for continued growth through technology-enabled transformation, scalable digital capabilities, and modern enterprise platforms.
Responsibilities

Technology Strategy & Innovation

Develop and execute Citadel's technology modernization roadmap and future-state technology strategy.
Owns enterprise integration, payment-system interoperability, fintech connectivity, real-time payment capabilities, and architectural evaluation of emerging financial technologies and digital currency. Partner with executive leadership to align technology investments with strategic business priorities.
Establish technology standards, governance frameworks, and engineering practices that support scalability, quality, and innovation.
Drive continuous modernization of applications, platforms, integrations, and enterprise technology capabilities.
Partner with the VP, Infrastructure & Cloud to align cloud architecture, landing-zone capabilities, infrastructure roadmaps, resiliency patterns, engineering platforms, and application-modernization requirements.

Software Engineering Leadership

Provide executive leadership for enterprise software engineering, application development, integration services, and DevOps functions.
Establish engineering standards and development methodologies
Quality Engineering, including test automation, performance testing, release-quality standards, and continuous improvement of software quality across the SDLC.
Drive application modernization initiatives that improve scalability, reliability, and business agility.
Lead software delivery capabilities that support digital banking, lending, operational, and member-facing solutions.
Champion continuous improvement across development, release management, and deployment practices.

Enterprise Architecture & Technology Simplification

Define and maintain Citadel's target-state technology architecture.
Establish enterprise technology standards and architectural governance.
Lead technology rationalization efforts, reducing complexity and technical debt across the organization.
Ensure technology investments align with long-term architectural objectives.
Oversee integration strategy and enterprise interoperability across systems and platforms.

Enterprise Data Services

Lead enterprise data platforms, data engineering, data quality, governance technologies, metadata management, data integration capabilities, and and AI-ready data foundations
Ensure scalable and secure data services that support organizational decision-making and growth.
Partner with Finance and Analytics teams to enable effective access to enterprise data.
Establish data platform strategies that support reporting, analytics, automation, and future AI initiatives.
Oversee enterprise data architecture and information management capabilities.

AI & Automation

Develop and execute Citadel's enterprise AI and automation strategy, including architecture, platforms, engineering, automation standards, reusable capabilities, adoption enablement, technology performance, and value measurement.
Oversee AI platforms, intelligent automation solutions, and emerging technology capabilities.
Establish governance, standards, and responsible use practices related to AI technologies.
Identify opportunities to automate processes, improve efficiency, and enhance employee and member experiences.
Monitor adoption, business value realization, and performance of AI-enabled solutions.

Enterprise Platforms & Business Systems

Provide strategic oversight for enterprise technology platforms, core banking systems, and business applications.
Develop long-term platform roadmaps that support business growth and operational efficiency.
Oversee application lifecycle management, technology refresh planning, and platform modernization efforts.
Ensure enterprise platforms are scalable, resilient, and aligned with organizational priorities.
Partner with business leaders to maximize value realization from technology investments.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.
Minimum of 10 years of progressive technology leadership experience, including responsibility for engineering, architecture, platforms, or enterprise technology functions.
Demonstrated success leading large-scale technology modernization and transformation initiatives.
Strong knowledge of software engineering, enterprise architecture, cloud technologies, data platforms, AI, automation, systems integration, and enterprise applications.
Experience developing and executing enterprise technology strategies aligned to business objectives.
Proven ability to lead cross-functional technology organizations and deliver complex technology programs.
Strong understanding of technology governance, architecture standards, security principles, and operational excellence.
Exceptional leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
